profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Always looking for new opportunities. I'm a fast willing learner. I enjoy the challenge of application development  where I am currently. Front End and Back End. I have a lot of family locally here in Mid Missouri. I am looking for remote work and reasonably local work, not willing to relocate. After serving and being gone for so long I don't want to miss anything else.

positions.title: Sergeant
positions.locationName: Ft. Polk, LA Ft. Campbell, KY Ft. Sill, OK Afghanistan
positions.description: 13F Forward Observer, I was responsible for all platoon level fire support planning and implementation. Anything larger than what we carried with us, Artillery, Mortars, Fixed and Rotary Wing Aircraft, getting them into the fight with us and utilizing their capabilities. As a Non Commissioned Officer I had additional duties to my soldiers to provide for their welfare; to train them and motivate them to be better each day. I deployed to Afghanistan 3 times over the course of my 6 years.
